products.name: 4MP Smart Dome CCTV Camera
products.short: Indoor/outdoor dome camera with night vision, motion alerts, and clear 4MP recording.
products.details: A compact CCTV dome camera for homes, offices, shops, and warehouses. It supports sharp day/night footage, vandal-resistant installation, and mobile monitoring through supported DVR/NVR systems.

products.name: 8 Channel NVR Security Kit
products.short: Reliable NVR kit for multi-camera security recording with remote viewing support.
products.details: A strong base system for CCTV installations that need central recording, multiple camera connections, and easy playback. Ideal for retail, buildings, and business premises.

products.name: 8 Port PoE Network Switch
products.short: Power and connect IP cameras with one stable network switch.
products.details: A PoE switch built for CCTV camera networks. It reduces cabling complexity by sending power and data through a single Ethernet cable for supported IP cameras.

products.name: Premium CCTV Cable Roll
products.short: Durable cable roll for clean and stable CCTV camera installations.
products.details: High-quality CCTV cable for reliable video and power transmission across residential and commercial camera setups.

products.name: Surveillance Hard Drive 2TB
products.short: Continuous recording storage built for security systems.
products.details: A CCTV-friendly hard drive for 24/7 recording workloads. Use it with DVR or NVR systems to store and replay footage with confidence.

products.name: 12V CCTV Power Supply
products.short: Stable power adapter for compatible CCTV cameras.
products.details: A dependable power supply for camera installations where clean and consistent voltage is important for reliable operation.
